region: Europe, Africa, Middle East and western USSR
scope: Fresh source-image review of every current/proposed naval-facility claim and printed coasts in the listed territories, including missing land tiles. Symbols checked: minor/major ports, minor/major dockyards, minor/major shipyards, seaplane bases and submarine bases. Every empty roster is an inspected absence. Iceland/Faroe/Shetland are covered by Americas/Atlantic; Kola and new eastern Soviet territories by Asia/Pacific. Interior land zones without coast or a prior naval claim are not separately listed. No production data changed.
